alt: Email from the T-Mobile Office of the CEO (Leila) acknowledging receipt of a formal complaint regarding device unlock refusal (January 27, 2026).
summary: This correspondence from the T-Mobile Office of the CEO, dated January 27, 2026, serves as an official acknowledgement of a formal complaint escalated to the executive level (originally addressed to Mike Sievert). The record confirms that T-Mobile has initiated an internal review of the device unlock dispute following the submission of technical evidence regarding retail misrepresentation. Forensically, this document represents the transition of the dispute from standard customer support to executive oversight, establishing a timeline for T-Mobile's corporate accountability in the ongoing investigation.
full_text: The FCC informs you that your complaint, Ticket No. 8382473, was served on the provider on January 26, 2026. The provider must contact you directly and submit a written response to the FCC within 30 days. The FCC will not contact you again until the provider responds. A link to the FCC FAQ page is included.
